interpretation: Exploratory paired64-query inferred age-geometry factorial. Uses same existing validation parents as plain anchor tuning, no final test. Age/scalar-age versus repeated-plain geometry, depth and coupling attributed only with matched completed controls. No superiority or distinct novelty claim.

model_configuration.anchor_grid: equal physical cell midpoints with cell-width masses
model_configuration.source_encoder: same independent plain-boundary GNN and observed selected features
model_configuration.memory_interface: queries only; references clamped independently encoded observed sources
model_configuration.scale_mixture: softmax over scales, global per layer/channel, separate branch states
model_configuration.normalization: matching ones query/reference source scans; no floor
model_configuration.source_maps: bounded tanh q/r, shared across scales in each layer
model_configuration.self_term: inclusive forward plus exclusive reverse counts once
model_configuration.decoder: each layer exact readout-coordinate action from its fixed anchor sources and same gate
model_configuration.limitations: finite anchor action, no continuous nonlinear integral or anchor-refinement guarantee; no performance/novelty result
